name: Three Bean Salad
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: oz. can cut wax beans, drained
oz. can French style green beans, drained
oz. can red kidney beans, drained

instructions:
In medium bowl, toss together wax beans, green beans, kidney beans, onion and Wish-Bone Italian Dressing. Cover and refrigerate; marinate several hours, tossing occasionally.
Makes 10 servings.
